An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
